status: Placeholder layout (SAM3D design). Seats, panels and positions are not from any source and only need to be reachable and readable; replace them when real cabin references or the creator's panel art are available. Lamp meanings follow the SAM Simulator manual where it gives them.
notes: Body frame: metres, x right, y forward, z up, from the ground under the hull centre. The placeholder hull in Unreal is 9.1 x 2.8 m with its roof at 2.2 m. Lamp sources use the source ids of data/procedures/osa_ak.json. Red dots (red_dot) are only given where a picture shows one: they mark a control's working position, not where it starts (docs/research/OSA_CONSOLE_MAP_2026-10.md §12).

controls.notes: One turn of the hand wheel = 60 degrees of azimuth (SAM3D estimate, for playability).
SAM3D estimate, for playability. The wheel's unit is in data/procedures/osa_ak.json.
One turn = 20 degrees of elevation (SAM3D estimate, for playability).

lamps.label: generator on line
lamps.notes: No source for this lamp; shows the subsystem state.

lamps.label: ГТА running
lamps.notes: No source for this lamp; shows the subsystem state. On the driver's panel with the ГТА (PU-303, rwd_mb3).

lamps.label: АПУ unlocked
lamps.notes: No source for this lamp; shows the subsystem state.

lamps.label: search antenna raised
lamps.notes: No source for this lamp; shows the subsystem state.

lamps.label: power
lamps.notes: No source for this lamp; shows the subsystem state.

lamps.label: equipment fault
lamps.notes: No source for this lamp; tells the commander something faulted (e.g. driving with the АПУ unlocked).

lamps.label: ГОТОВ
lamps.source: samsim_osa p15 photo; samsim_game (lit at the start, goes out when ВЫСОКОЕ is on)
lamps.notes: Shares one window with ВЫСОК. on OP81-16M. Meaning (transmitter ready) inferred from the label.

lamps.label: ВЫСОК.
lamps.source: samsim_osa p15 photo; samsim_game (lights red with ВЫСОКОЕ ВКЛ)

lamps.label: III ЛУЧ
lamps.notes: The lit beam indicator. With I–III or I–II selected the game steps the lamp from beam to beam as the antenna scans; SAM3D lights none then (not modelled).

lamps.label: I ЛУЧ
lamps.source: samsim_osa p15; samsim_game (lit at the start)

lamps.label: ГОТОВ
lamps.source: samsim_osa p16, p24 photos; samsim_game (lit at the start, out with the transmitter on)
lamps.notes: Meaning (transmitter ready) inferred from the label.

lamps.label: ВКЛ. ВЫСОК.
lamps.source: samsim_osa p16, p24 photos; samsim_game (lights red with ПЕРЕДАТЧИК ВКЛ)

lamps.label: ТСЦ
lamps.source: samsim_osa p24; panel: flak11 (the operator captures with ТСЦ)
lamps.notes: Angle tracking lamp. The console models angle and range tracking as one subsystem.

lamps.label: АВТОМАТ
lamps.notes: Range tracking lamp; same subsystem as ТСЦ.

lamps.label: ВНИМАНИЕ
lamps.notes: Colour: sam3d estimate.

lamps.label: ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ
lamps.notes: Colour: sam3d estimate.

lamps.label: ЗАХВАТ
lamps.notes: First lamp of missile preparation. The console has one missile_prep subsystem, so this lights as soon as preparation starts.

lamps.label: ВКЛ ВЫС
lamps.notes: Lights when preparation is done in this model; the real intermediate stage isn't modelled.

lamps.label: НЛЦ
lamps.notes: Panel and colour: sam3d estimate.

lamps.label: РУ
lamps.source: samsim_osa p17, p23 photos; samsim_game (lit at the start; out with ЦУ, back with РУ)
lamps.notes: Manual mode lamp, above the РУ button.

lamps.label: АЗ
lamps.source: samsim_game (ЦУ lights ЦУ and АЗ together)
lamps.notes: Above the АЗ button, which does nothing by itself in the game.

lamps.label: БР
lamps.source: samsim_osa p29 photo; samsim_game (lights when РОД РАБОТЫ is turned to БР)

lamps.label: ГОТОВ СПК (II)
lamps.source: samsim_osa p18; samsim_game (lit on both channels at the start)
lamps.notes: Command-link transmitter ready, per channel (OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md). Lit whenever there is power until the channels are modelled (6.3).

lamps.label: ГОТОВ СПК (I)
lamps.source: samsim_osa p18; samsim_game (lit on both channels at the start)
lamps.notes: As ГОТОВ СПК (II).

lamps.label: ЛЮКИ ЗАКР.
lamps.source: samsim_osa p29 photo; samsim_game (lit at the start)
lamps.notes: Hatches closed. SAM3D has no hatches yet, so it is lit whenever there is power.

lamps.label: АВАР. ПУСК ОБЕСТОЧ.
lamps.source: samsim_osa p29 photo; samsim_game (lit at the start, guard closed)
lamps.notes: Emergency launch de-energised. Tied to the closed guard in SAM3D (estimate).

displays.label: SOC indicator
displays.notes: Search picture up to 45 km on the selected scale, with the SSC azimuth line and range gate the operator puts on the target mark (p22). Sweep period, afterglow, the 10-45 km scale drawn as a delayed sweep (centre = 10 km), the clutter disc and the gate marker are SAM3D estimates.

displays.label: Range indicator
displays.notes: Two sweeps: the upper shows 0-28 km with the target as a spike, the lower a 1.5 km magnification around the range gates. The counter shows the range wheel (p24 item 2).

displays.label: βс
displays.notes: SSC azimuth in Russian military angle (60-00 = 360 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: TOV monitor
displays.notes: The camera looks along the SSC azimuth and elevation with the wide or narrow lens; crosshair at the centre.

displays.label: εс
displays.notes: SSC elevation in Russian military angle (15-00 = 90 deg); ПОДСВЕТКА lights it. Dial face: SAM3D estimate.

displays.label: ДЦ
displays.notes: Measured target distance, 10 V = 10 km. Reads while the SSC tracks in range (the range wheel follows the target then); rests at 0 otherwise. Full scale 30 V: SAM3D estimate.
